protocol.selection: Most recent rating >=4 by timestamp; lower movie ID on tied timestamp
protocol.isolation: Remove only the held-out user-item cell from ratingMatrix, run both unmodified recommenders, restore in finally before next user
protocol.candidateIdentity: Capture internal movie IDs after the existing sorter; do not match titles
protocol.tieBreaking: Neighbor similarity descending, then user ID ascending; candidate score descending, then movie ID ascending (exact numeric ties)
protocol.metric: HitRate@5 = hits/evaluated; MRR@5 = sum(1/rank for hits, 0 for misses)/evaluated
